component.name: Painto
component.summary: Draw and write over your desktop, including videos

description.p: Whether you're taking notes during a presentation, sketching ideas while watching a tutorial, or simply having fun with digital doodles, Painto seamlessly integrates with your screen activity.
With a single click, you can toggle between normal computer operations and drawing mode, ensuring that your annotations remain visible without interrupting your workflow.
Painto is designed for anyone who values creativity, productivity, and the freedom to express ideas anywhere on their screen.
